stage1.impression: A moody, warm, well-composed long view of a timber-and-concrete bar that holds together as a mood board, but at 1:1 it reads as CG. The fir ceiling looks blurred and ruddy, the floor has a hard, unmotivated wedge of raking light, the frosted panels on the right read as flat purple-grey canvases, and identical stools, chairs, tables and orbs repeat down the room. The hero speakers on the far altar are small, grey-white and dim (their smoke tint does not read), while the speaker in the back-bar niche and the white orbs pull the eye first. As it stands, a magazine would see a generic upscale hotel bar, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The altar pair must read as the hero at a glance: speaker regions lum_median >= 45, with the smoked acrylic tint and glowing polished edges visible, not grey-white boxes
The altar speakers must be the brightest, most saturated object in the frame, ahead of the back-bar niche speaker (now median 120 against 23 to 29 at the altar)
The fir ceiling must lose its orange cast (now r 55 / b 13 median) and show real checks, nail holes and end grain, not a soft smeared texture
The frosted screens must glow evenly as thick frosted acrylic with lit edges, not read as matte purple prints in frames
The floor light must be motivated by the visible practicals; the hard-edged wedge from the left reads as sunlight or a CG spot
Repetition must be broken by props and placement: chairs at different angles, glasses at different levels, a menu or coat at the tables
Remove the sepia, lifted-matte grade and the uniform grain that sits like a filter over every surface

defects.what: Left altar speaker: lum_median 28.6, grey-white face with near-black surround; the smoked tint and the light through the acrylic do not read; the top lamp area clips
Right altar speaker: lum_median 22.8, same as the left; also partly cut by the doorway/screen edge
Back-bar niche speaker is brighter (median 120) than the altar pair and competes as the hero
Ceiling beams strongly orange (r 55, g 28, b 13), with soft, smeared grain; they read as a texture, not old fir
Frosted screens read as flat purple-grey canvases in frames: no edge glow, no thickness, uneven blotchy image
Hard-edged diagonal wedge of light across the floor from frame left, not explained by any visible practical; the shadows look like a single CG spot
Orb lamps read as plain white glowing globes (median 128); the smoked tint is lost, and they compete with the speakers
Identical stools, chairs and tables repeat in rigid rows at the same angle (a catalogue look)
Uniform sepia matte grade with filter-like grain over every surface; denoiser softness on the speakers and back wall
Zinc counter top a flat light grey (median 122) with no patina or reflection of the pendants

changes.problem: The altar pair, the hero, fills under 2 % of the frame and is half hidden behind the doorway, so the speaker cannot be read at a glance.

evidence.measured: each speaker about 130 x 260 px of a 2400 x 1600 frame; the right one is clipped by the screen edge

changes.expected: The altar pair sits centred in the opening and roughly doubles in size (about 260 x 520 px each), with both cabinets fully visible; the counter and banquette still frame the left and right.

changes.problem: The altar speakers are too dark and their smoked acrylic does not glow; the white batts dominate.

evidence.measured: lum_median 28.6 (right 22.8), p95 222: a few bright highlights over a dark body

change.setting: altar spots / lamps on each speaker
change.from: altar 2 x spot 170 W, cone 30 deg; speaker area lamps 1.0 W/m2 at 2900 K
change.to: altar 2 x spot 220 W, cone 22 deg, aimed at the cabinets' mid-height; speaker area lamps 3.0 W/m2 at 2900 K, set behind and grazing so the cabinet edges glow

changes.expected: Speaker bodies median 50 to 80, the polished edges a bright line, and the smoked tint visible as a warm grey-brown through the acrylic.

changes.problem: The back-bar niche speaker is brighter than the altar pair and steals the hero role.

change.setting: the lit niche's strip / record wall spots
change.from: niche strip 6.0, record wall spots 6.0 W
change.to: niche strip 2.0, record wall spots 4.0 W

changes.expected: The niche speaker drops to a supporting role (median about 60 to 75), below the altar pair.

changes.problem: The grade is an orange-sepia filter: the ceiling is saturated orange, which breaks the 'one colour from the product' rule, and the lifted matte look reads as an app filter.

evidence.measured: r_median 55, g 28, b 13 on the beams

change.from: white_balance_k 3000, look AgX - Medium High Contrast, plus the sepia finish
change.to: white_balance_k 2650, look AgX - Medium High Contrast, no sepia/matte finish, grain halved

changes.expected: Warm but neutral timber (r/b ratio about 2.2 instead of 4.2) and concrete reading as warm grey; the speaker becomes the only saturated note.

changes.problem: The hard wedge of light across the floor has no visible source and reads as a CG spot or daylight in a night room.

evidence.measured: a sharp-edged diagonal band with crisp chair-leg shadows, unlike the soft pools under the Domes

change.from: street lamps 2 x point 8.0 W; Dome downlights cone 20 deg
change.to: street lamps 3.0 W with a 0.15 m radius; Dome downlights cone 28 deg so each lands as a soft pool on the counter and floor

changes.expected: The floor shows soft pools under each pendant and table, falling off to dark between them, with no raking wedge.

changes.problem: The frosted screens read as matte purple canvases, not thick frosted acrylic, so the acrylic does not read premium.

evidence.measured: flat, blotchy grey-violet fill, no edge glow, no thickness

change.setting: the screens' images / frosted acrylic roughness
change.from: screens' images 0.03, frosted roughness as now
change.to: screens' images 0.06, with the image toned toward a warm neutral; frosted roughness 0.35 with a lit 25 mm polished edge

changes.expected: The screens glow softly and evenly with a bright edge line and read as thick frosted panels; the region median is about 70 to 90 and neutral.

changes.problem: The Orbs blaze as plain white globes; their smoked tint is lost and they compete with the hero.
changes.expected: The Orbs read as smoked glass with a warm inner glow (median about 80 to 100), lighting the table tops as small pools.

changes.problem: Identical seats and tables in rigid rows at one angle read as a catalogue render with no sign of life.

evidence.measured: eight identical stools and four chairs all at one rotation; one glass per table, at the same spot

change.from: seats at uniform rotation; round 39 props
change.to: rotate chairs and stools by -15 to +20 deg at random; pull one chair out; add a half-drunk glass and a folded menu to two tables, a jacket over the nearest chair, and a record sleeve on the counter in view

changes.expected: The room reads as used minutes ago; the repetition is broken.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speakers' smoked tint more saturated so they carry more colour
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour and parts are fixed; only their light can change.

out_of_scope.request: Vary the seat models (mix two chair designs)
out_of_scope.why: The seats are part of the room's design as fixed on the card.

out_of_scope.request: Bring the altar forward or widen the doorway to the listening room
out_of_scope.why: The layout and the altar are fixed.
